theorem QOU.Archimedean.transferMatrix_swap (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : R_t) (M : TMatrix) :
M * transferMatrix a₁ b₁ * transferMatrix a₂ b₂ = M * transferMatrix a₂ b₂ * transferMatrix a₁ b₁

theorem QOU.Archimedean.transferMatrix_comm (a b c d : R_t) :
transferMatrix a b * transferMatrix c d = transferMatrix c d * transferMatrix a b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.HeckeRep.braid_far {n d : ℕ} (self : HeckeRep n d) (i j : Fin (n - 1)) :
↑i + 2 ≤ ↑j → self.gen i * self.gen j = self.gen j * self.gen i

theorem QOU.Archimedean.HeckeRep.braid_adj {n d : ℕ} (self : HeckeRep n d) (i : ℕ) (hi₀ : i < n - 1) (hi₁ : i + 1 < n - 1) :
self.gen ⟨i, hi₀⟩ * self.gen ⟨i + 1, hi₁⟩ * self.gen ⟨i, hi₀⟩ = self.gen ⟨i + 1, hi₁⟩ * self.gen ⟨i, hi₀⟩ * self.gen ⟨i + 1, hi₁⟩

theorem QOU.Archimedean.HeckeRep.hecke_rel {n d : ℕ} (self : HeckeRep n d) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
self.gen i * self.gen i = HA_t • self.gen i + 1
